name: Okran's Valley
description: Okran's Valley lies in the north of the Holy Nation, between the two ranges of the Arm of Okran, and runs north toward Bast and the United Cities. A conifer forest covers its southern end, but most of it is desert, and water is scarce. A few Holy farms work the land, and the farms nearest Bast lie in ruins. Holy army patrols and inquisitors pass through often, alongside escaped servants and starving bandits.
